author: Unreal Engine
description: Join us live on May 27 at 2 PM ET as Squatingdog hosts Epic Games' Harold Emsheimer and Jon Fox for a walkthrough of how Discover works, what recent updates mean for developers, and how the experience will continue to evolve. They’ll answer your questions live and share more context you can apply to your own islands. See you in the chat!
title: Let’s Chat Discover w/ Squatingdog

author: Unreal Engine
description: Join us on June 17 at 9AM CT for news about Epic’s developer tools and services, highlights from across the community and a look at what’s ahead. Expect real conversations, not massive live tech demos: https://epic.gm/unreal-fest-chicago-state-of-unreal
title: State of Unreal returns in 3 weeks at Unreal Fest Chicago!
